# One case per "--- name" block. "env K=V" lines set the environment for that case only, after every PG*
# variable is cleared and PGPASSFILE/PGSERVICEFILE point at missing files. "dsn" is the rest of the line.
# $W is replaced with the run's work directory. Names starting "named " are expected to differ.

--- empty dsn reads the defaults
dsn

--- environment supplies everything
env PGHOST=db.example.com
env PGPORT=6543
env PGUSER=envuser
env PGDATABASE=envdb
env PGPASSWORD=envpw
env PGAPPNAME=envapp
env PGOPTIONS=-c search_path=x
env PGTZ=UTC
dsn

--- environment is overridden by the url
env PGHOST=db.example.com
env PGUSER=envuser
dsn postgres://urluser@urlhost:5440/urldb

--- empty environment values are ignored
env PGHOST=
env PGUSER=
dsn host=h

--- url basic
dsn postgres://u:p@h:5433/db?sslmode=disable

--- url postgresql scheme
dsn postgresql://u@h/db

--- url without user or path
dsn postgres://h

--- url empty
dsn postgres://

--- url only scheme and path
dsn postgres:///db

--- url user without password
dsn postgres://alice@h/db

--- url empty password
dsn postgres://alice:@h/db

--- url percent-encoded credentials
dsn postgres://al%40ice:p%3Aw%2Fd@h/db

--- url bad escape in password
dsn postgres://u:p%zz@h/db

--- url invalid userinfo
dsn postgres://u ser:p@h/db

--- url control character
dsn postgres://h/db	tab

--- url multiple hosts and ports
dsn postgres://u@h1:5001,h2:5002,h3/db

--- url multiple hosts sharing one port
dsn postgres://u@h1,h2,h3:5009/db

--- url ipv6 with port
dsn postgres://u@[::1]:5432/db

--- url ipv6 without port
dsn postgres://[::1]/db

--- url ipv6 v4 literal refused
dsn postgres://[127.0.0.1]:5432/db

--- url ipv6 missing bracket
dsn postgres://[::1/db

--- url invalid port
dsn postgres://h:abc/db

--- url port out of range
dsn postgres://h:70000/db

--- url port zero
dsn postgres://h:0/db

--- url host with bad character
dsn postgres://h^x/db

--- url empty host before port
dsn postgres://:5432/db

--- url query params become runtime params
dsn postgres://h/?dbname=qdb&application_name=app&search_path=s1&timezone=UTC

--- url first duplicate query value wins
dsn postgres://h/db?application_name=one&application_name=two

--- url query with plus and escapes
dsn postgres://h/db?options=-c%20search_path%3Dfoo+bar

--- url query semicolon pair dropped
dsn postgres://h/db?application_name=a;b&search_path=s

--- url fragment ignored
dsn postgres://h/db#frag

--- url bad fragment escape
dsn postgres://h/db#%zz

--- url force query
dsn postgres://h/db?

--- url path escapes
dsn postgres://h/my%20db

--- uppercase scheme falls back to keyword value
dsn POSTGRES://h/db

--- keyword value basic
dsn host=h port=1234 user=u password=pw dbname=d sslmode=require

--- keyword value quoted value with spaces
dsn host=h password='p w' application_name='my app'

--- keyword value escapes
dsn host=h password=a\ b\\c application_name='it\'s'

--- keyword value spaces around equals
dsn host = h  port =  5555   user=u

--- keyword value empty user is skipped
env PGUSER=envuser
dsn host=h user=

--- keyword value unterminated quote
dsn host=h password='oops

--- keyword value missing equals
dsn host=h port

--- keyword value empty key
dsn =x host=h

--- keyword value trailing backslash
dsn host=h password=abc\

--- keyword value empty value then key
dsn host= port=5432

--- keyword value dbname maps to database
dsn host=h dbname=mydb

--- keyword value unknown keys become runtime params
dsn host=h search_path=a,b work_mem=64MB

--- several hosts with fewer ports
dsn host=a,b,c port=1,2

--- several hosts with bad later port
dsn host=a,b port=1,x

--- unix socket host has no tls
dsn host=/tmp port=5467 user=u sslmode=require

--- unix socket and tcp mixed
dsn host=/tmp,h port=5467,5432

--- unix socket path is cleaned
dsn host=/tmp//sub/../ port=5467

--- sslmode disable
dsn host=h sslmode=disable

--- sslmode allow
dsn host=h sslmode=allow

--- sslmode prefer is the default
dsn host=h

--- sslmode require
dsn host=h sslmode=require

--- sslmode verify-ca without root cert
dsn host=h sslmode=verify-ca

--- sslmode verify-full without root cert
dsn host=h sslmode=verify-full

--- sslmode verify-full with ip host
dsn host=127.0.0.1 sslmode=verify-full

--- sslmode invalid
dsn host=h sslmode=bogus

--- sslmode from environment
env PGSSLMODE=require
dsn host=h

--- root cert with require becomes chain verification
dsn host=h sslmode=require sslrootcert=$W/ca.crt

--- root cert with verify-ca
dsn host=h sslmode=verify-ca sslrootcert=$W/ca.crt

--- root cert with verify-full
dsn host=h sslmode=verify-full sslrootcert=$W/ca.crt

--- root cert with prefer stays unverified
dsn host=h sslrootcert=$W/ca.crt

--- root cert system forces verify-full
dsn host=h sslmode=require sslrootcert=system

--- root cert missing file
dsn host=h sslmode=verify-ca sslrootcert=$W/missing.crt

--- root cert not pem
dsn host=h sslmode=verify-ca sslrootcert=$W/garbage.pem

--- root cert ignored for unix socket
dsn host=/tmp sslmode=verify-ca sslrootcert=$W/missing.crt

--- sslsni off
dsn host=h sslmode=require sslsni=0

--- sslsni off still names the host for verify-full
dsn host=h sslmode=verify-full sslsni=0 sslrootcert=$W/ca.crt

--- sslsni with ip host
dsn host=10.0.0.1 sslmode=require

--- direct negotiation upgrades prefer to require
dsn host=h sslnegotiation=direct

--- direct negotiation with disable
dsn host=h sslnegotiation=direct sslmode=disable

--- client cert and key
dsn host=h sslmode=require sslcert=$W/client.crt sslkey=$W/client.key

--- client cert with pkcs1 key
dsn host=h sslmode=require sslcert=$W/client.crt sslkey=$W/client-pkcs1.key

--- client cert without key
dsn host=h sslmode=require sslcert=$W/client.crt

--- client key without cert
dsn host=h sslmode=require sslkey=$W/client.key

--- client key missing
dsn host=h sslmode=require sslcert=$W/client.crt sslkey=$W/missing.key

--- client key not pem
dsn host=h sslmode=require sslcert=$W/client.crt sslkey=$W/garbage.pem

--- client cert missing
dsn host=h sslmode=require sslcert=$W/missing.crt sslkey=$W/client.key

--- client cert does not match key
dsn host=h sslmode=require sslcert=$W/ca.crt sslkey=$W/client.key

--- client encrypted key without password
dsn host=h sslmode=require sslcert=$W/client.crt sslkey=$W/client-enc.key

--- named client encrypted key with password
dsn host=h sslmode=require sslcert=$W/client.crt sslkey=$W/client-enc.key sslpassword=secret

--- client cert ignored when sslmode disable
dsn host=h sslmode=disable sslcert=$W/client.crt

--- connect timeout
dsn host=h connect_timeout=5

--- connect timeout zero
dsn host=h connect_timeout=0

--- connect timeout negative
dsn host=h connect_timeout=-1

--- connect timeout not a number
dsn host=h connect_timeout=abc

--- connect timeout with plus sign
dsn host=h connect_timeout=+7

--- connect timeout from environment
env PGCONNECT_TIMEOUT=9
dsn host=h

--- target session attrs read-write
dsn host=h target_session_attrs=read-write

--- target session attrs read-only
dsn host=h target_session_attrs=read-only

--- target session attrs primary
dsn host=h target_session_attrs=primary

--- target session attrs standby
dsn host=h target_session_attrs=standby

--- target session attrs prefer-standby
dsn host=h target_session_attrs=prefer-standby

--- target session attrs unknown
dsn host=h target_session_attrs=bogus

--- target session attrs empty
dsn host=h target_session_attrs=

--- protocol min 3.2 raises max
dsn host=h min_protocol_version=3.2

--- protocol max latest
dsn host=h max_protocol_version=latest

--- protocol min above explicit max
dsn host=h min_protocol_version=3.2 max_protocol_version=3.0

--- protocol min invalid
dsn host=h min_protocol_version=4

--- protocol max invalid
dsn host=h max_protocol_version=x

--- channel binding require
dsn host=h channel_binding=require

--- channel binding disable
dsn host=h channel_binding=disable

--- channel binding unknown
dsn host=h channel_binding=always

--- pgx statement cache capacity is consumed
dsn host=h statement_cache_capacity=100 description_cache_capacity=50

--- pgx statement cache capacity invalid
dsn host=h statement_cache_capacity=abc

--- pgx description cache capacity out of range
dsn host=h description_cache_capacity=99999999999

--- pgx default query exec mode valid
dsn host=h default_query_exec_mode=simple_protocol

--- pgx default query exec mode invalid
dsn host=h default_query_exec_mode=fast

--- passfile supplies the password
env PGPASSFILE=$W/pgpass
dsn host=db.example.com dbname=app user=alice

--- passfile wildcard with escaped colon
env PGPASSFILE=$W/pgpass
dsn host=other.example.com port=6543 user=bob dbname=x

--- passfile matches localhost for a unix socket
env PGPASSFILE=$W/pgpass
dsn host=/tmp user=carol

--- passfile does not override an explicit password
env PGPASSFILE=$W/pgpass
dsn host=db.example.com dbname=app user=alice password=given

--- passfile no match
env PGPASSFILE=$W/pgpass
dsn host=nomatch.example.com user=dave

--- passfile from the connection string
dsn host=db.example.com dbname=app user=alice passfile=$W/pgpass

--- service from environment
env PGSERVICEFILE=$W/services.conf
env PGSERVICE=svc
dsn

--- service from the connection string with override
env PGSERVICEFILE=$W/services.conf
dsn service=svc port=7100

--- service missing
env PGSERVICEFILE=$W/services.conf
dsn service=nope

--- service file missing
dsn service=svc

--- service file malformed
env PGSERVICEFILE=$W/badservices.conf
dsn service=svc

--- service file named in the connection string
dsn service=svc servicefile=$W/services.conf

--- redaction of a url password on a later error
dsn postgres://u:secret@h:5432/db?sslmode=bogus

--- redaction of a url password with port error
dsn postgres://u:secret@h:99999/db

--- redaction of a keyword password
dsn host=h password=secret sslmode=bogus

--- redaction of a quoted keyword password
dsn host=h password='sec ret' connect_timeout=x

--- redaction of a broken url
dsn postgres://u:secret@h/db%zz

--- krb settings are not runtime params
dsn host=h krbsrvname=postgres krbspn=x

--- options and application name from environment and dsn
env PGOPTIONS=-c work_mem=1MB
dsn host=h application_name=fromdsn
